item.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

turns.text: Make this pic of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.**

Suggested 8-second line, in a friendly, upbeat male English voice:
> “Hey there! Our sale is on, and we’d love for you to take a look. Come check it out!”

I’d keep your square framing and request no captions.

**Cost and free-plan limits**
- I can’t verify an exact credit quote or your balance with the tools available here, so I won’t run a paid generation without that information and your approval.
- The scripted-video tool limits free accounts to **5 seconds unless a credit pack has been purchased**. Your requested 8 seconds is therefore blocked unless that exception applies.
- **480p is the lowest available video resolution** for this workflow.

**Lower-cost option:** a **5-second, square, 480p** clip saying:
> “Our sale is on! Come take a look—we’d love to see you!”

Shortening the clip is the clearest way to reduce usage; I can’t confirm the credit savings without a quote.

One important catch: Magic Hour’s guidance says **commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage arrangement**. A sale promo falls into that category, so a free-only account isn’t sufficient for publishing it commercially.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

dialog.agent:
The cheapest option listed is **5 seconds, square, 480p, no captions**, with:
> “Our sale is on! Come take a look—we’d love to see you!”

Before I run it: **have you purchased a Magic Hour credit pack?** Its guidance requires a paid arrangement for commercial use, including this sale promo.

I also can’t retrieve an exact credit quote through this connection, so I can’t honor your cost-before-running requirement yet. Please check the price shown in Magic Hour and share it here. **No generation has started or credits been spent.**
dialog.user: I’m on the free plan, and I don’t have a credit quote to share. Please don’t run anything until the cost is confirmed.

turns.agent:
Understood—**I won’t run anything or spend credits until the cost is confirmed and you approve it.**

The proposed option remains a 5-second square video at 480p, with a friendly male English voice and no captions:
> “Our sale is on! Come take a look—we’d love to see you!”

I can’t retrieve an exact credit quote through this connection. Commercial-use eligibility also needs to be resolved before publishing the sale promo on a free-only account.
